title: Untitled meeting
rawTranscript:
Dana Cole: Thanks for making time. We want to lock renewal pricing before Q1.
Alex Rivera: We can offer a two-year term at the current rate, with a 5 percent discount if signed by December 15th.
Dana Cole: That works. I'll take it to procurement and get back to you by November 7th.
Alex Rivera: Agreed then: two-year term, current rate, 5 percent off if signed by December 15th. I'll send the formal quote tomorrow.
Dana Cole: One question: does the discount apply to add-on seats too?
Alex Rivera: Good question, I'll need to check with our finance team.
